underdome-irregulars.note: Runner action phase ends: if ice was rezzed this turn draw 2 or remove 1 tag, else trash this.

unity.note: Decoder 1 strength: 1 credit breaks 1 code gate subroutine; 1 credit +X strength, X = installed icebreakers.

unleash.note: Additional cost: remove 1 tag; rez 1 installed ice ignoring costs, may resolve 1 of its subroutines.

abilities: [subroutine] Give the Runner 1 tag. / [subroutine] Do 2 net damage. / [subroutine] You may draw 2 cards.
unsmiling-tsarevna.note: The IR has two subroutines, net damage then tag: the 'You may draw 2 cards' subroutine is missing and the first two are in the wrong order. The rez ability (give 2 credits, at most 1 printed subroutine broken per encounter) matches.

abilities: When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 2 net damage plus 1 per advancement counter
urtica-cipher.note: The card has no onAccessRequiresInstalled flag, so the damage also fires when it is accessed in HQ, R&D or Archives. Paired cut A: add the flag.

utae.note: Interface X credits breaks X code gate subroutines once per run; 1 credit breaks 1 with 3+ virtual resources; 1 credit +1 strength.

vampyronassa.note: Runner loses 2; gain 2; 2 net damage; may draw 1 or 2.

abilities: Once per turn → [click]: Install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs.
When the Runner trashes this asset, you may install 1 card from HQ, ignoring all costs. You cannot install that card in the root of this server.
vaporframe-fabricator.note: Area 5 (Corp install): both abilities install through install_hq_card_ignore_costs (inline, faceup, no new remote for ice, no trash of an agenda or asset in the root), as S1b found. Area 1 (trash hooks): onTrash fires when the Corp trashes it too. The excluded-root rule matches. cr-checker: CR 1.14.5a (who carries out the trash); it may also fire for an unrezzed card trashed on access (CR 9.1.8g), not tested.

abilities: When the Runner encounters this ice, you may pay 1[credit]. If you do, place 1 advancement counter on an installed card you can advance.
vasilisa.note: place_advancements has no pick, so the counter goes on the first advanceable card with no Corp choice. Also, the 1 credit is paid with lose_credits in a seq, so with 0 credits the counter is still placed (area 11 cost gating, the same gap S1b filed). The tag subroutine matches.

abilities: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may reveal the grip. Trash 1 card revealed this way.
vera-ivanovna-shuyskaya.note: may_trash_one_from_grip opens one Corp choice labelled with every grip card plus Decline. The Corp sees the grip before deciding to reveal, and can decline having learned it; the grip is never revealed to both players; and after a reveal the trash is mandatory, so Decline should not be offered then. Visibility: the Corp learns hidden information without the effect happening (game-host redaction of choice labels not checked).

verbal-plasticity.note: Unique; first basic draw action each turn draws 2 instead.

vertigo.note: On pass with no clicks left, Runner cannot steal or trash this run; Runner loses a click.

vicsek.note: X net damage and X tags, X = Runner's tags; 1 tag and trash this ice.

virtual-intelligence-p-i-you-can-call-me.note: Once per turn, click, 1 credit: draw 1 and remove 1 tag.

virtuoso.note: Unique console, +1 MU; turn begin identify mark; first successful mark run each turn: +1 HQ access if the mark is HQ, else breach HQ when the run ends.

abilities: Once per turn → 2 hosted advancement counters: Place 2 advancement counters on another card you can advance in the root of this server.
vladisibirsk-city-grid.note: place_advancements (sameServerRootAsSource) has no pick, so with more than one advanceable card in the root the counters go on the first one with no Corp choice. Cost, once per turn and the advanceable upgrade match.

vrcation.note: Draw 4; lose a click if any remain.

vulnerability-audit.note: Cannot be scored the turn it is installed.

wake-implant-v2a-jrj.note: Unique; 1 meat damage on install; power counter on each successful HQ run; on R&D breach may remove up to 3 for that many more accesses (a choice of how many, src/state/access.ts).

wall-to-wall.note: Unique; at Corp turn begin resolve 1 option if another asset is rezzed, otherwise up to 3 different ones: draw 1, gain 1, advance an installed ice, add Wall to Wall to HQ.

abilities: you may search R&D for a piece of ice and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that ice to HQ.
wave.note: search_rd_type_to_hq takes the first ice in R&D order: the Corp cannot choose which or fail to find. With no ice in R&D it does not shuffle (shuffleIfNone unset). Gaslight uses the same kind. The rez condition and the harmonic subroutine match.

abilities: Whenever you advance a card, gain 2 credits if it had no advancement counters
weyland-consortium-built-to-last.note: The 10.3.1a hook reads only cards advanced since the previous checkpoint (advanceCard, and Success's advance), so placing or moving counters no longer gains 2.
weyland-consortium-built-to-last.test: placing counters with Seamless Launch is not advancing, so it gains nothing (CR 1.18.2)

abilities: Whenever you make a successful run, you may trash this resource to choose a card name. The next time this run you access an agenda with the chosen name, steal it, ignoring all costs.
whistleblower.note: may_trash_name_agenda_steal_ignore_costs offers the title of every Corp card in the game, so the Runner's option list shows what is in HQ and R&D. It should accept any card name.

whitespace.note: Runner loses 3 credits; end the run if the Runner has 6 credits or less.

wildcat-strike.note: Corp chooses: Runner gains 6 credits or draws 4.

winchester.note: Trace 4: trash a program; trace 3: trash a hardware; while protecting HQ it gains 'trace 3: end the run' after its other subroutines.

witch-hunt.note: Bad publicity on score or steal; Corp action phase end after scoring it this turn: remove all tags, give 3.

word-on-the-street.note: Unique; additional cost to score an agenda installed this turn: Corp adds it to their score area as a -1 agenda they cannot forfeit; when the Corp scores an agenda not installed this turn, trash it, gain 4, draw 1.

abilities: you may trash 1 of your other installed cards to search your stack for 1 card of the same type. Install the card you found, paying 3[credit] less.
world-tree.note: Area 6 (Runner install): searchStackTypeInstall uses the same filters, so a program that would exceed free MU, a trojan or an install-on-ice program cannot be found and installed. The once-per-turn trigger, the trash and the discount match.

abilities: Whenever a player trashes a card (including this upgrade) from the root of this server or protecting it, except during installation, gain 2[credit].
yakov-erikovich-avdakov.note: maybeFireYakovCredits (src/effects/corpTrash.ts) pays for the trashed Yakov whether or not it was rezzed, so the Runner trashing an unrezzed Yakov on access gives the Corp 2. Hostile Architecture's trashedWasRezzed check is the pattern. Other cards in the server pay only while Yakov is rezzed, which matches.

zahya-sadeghi-versatile-smuggler.note: Once per turn, when an HQ or R&D run ends, may gain 1 credit per card accessed.

zato-city-grid.note: Remote only; ice protecting this server: on encounter the Corp may trash it to resolve 1 chosen subroutine.

zenit-chip-jz-2mj.note: Unique; 1 core damage on install; first successful central run each turn draws 1.
